entries.name: Demon types
entries.content:
Lesser demons:are the weakest ones typically can destroy buildings at max strength 

Greater demons: are the average and can usually level City blocks at max Power.

Dire Demons: Above average demons, can level multiple city blocks or entire Towns at max strength.

Elder Demons: Pinnacle of Demonic strength, can be threats to entire nations or multiple.

Demons: Horrifying distorted creatures with various abilities

Demons will form when negative energy thrives in an abundance in a large area and their appearance and abilities will be based on this energy.

Demons can also possess people when individuals come in contact with cursed objects who don’t have awareness or proper control over their own energy
